title: Quick-Fix Turkish Meat Manti
description: Peppery, dense Turkish dish featuring makrut lime leaves, easily cooked in a tandoor. This dairy-free-friendly version of manti can be prepared and cooked in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free option: rice flour or corn flour

instructions: Mix ground beef, all-purpose flour, makrut lime leaves, onion, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until just combined.
Divide the mixture into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin circle, about 3 inches in diameter.
Place 12-15 manti on a piece of parchment paper or a lightly floured surface, leaving space between each piece for even cooking.
Cook the manti in the preheated tandoor for 10-12 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are cooked through.
Serve hot with your choice of toppings, such as yogurt sauce, chopped fresh herbs, or pickled vegetables.
Note: If you don't have a tandoor, you can cook the manti in a conventional oven or on a grill, but the cooking time may vary.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
